B1 compulsory60EC; B2 compulsory55EC plus genuine5ECchoice; B3 compulsory50EC including15ECinternship and15ECthesis plus genuine10ECchoice. Published attendance requirements apply. Choice units may be at RU, other Dutch or partner universities; other institutions need Board consent. No duplicate bachelor/master credit.

conceptAdjudication.closest: Sustained media, rhetoric/persuasion, social psychology and empirical inquiry is a substantive response to communication science. Applied business courses have identified marketing/organisational roles and do not replace the specialist projects or thesis.
conceptAdjudication.second: Distinct technical/cognitive response to evidenced socialmedia/AI/human-machine direction, with substantial communication study retained. Technical planning/optimisation is complementary, not a direct HMC course match.
conceptAdjudication.stop: Health/well-being is evidenced but does not support a distinct coherent24course communication curriculum; biomedical padding would shift the field. Two is the supported maximum here.
